_doc: Supplement brand families: registrations of one brand that the FDA Philippines filed under variant brand names, merged onto one page.
Key = main brand slug (the page that stays); members = brand slugs merged into it; name = display name (optional; default the
main slug's own registered name). Each registration keeps its own product name and registered brand on the page.
Read by tools/drugdb/build_supplements.py. A merged slug that had a static page needs a 301 in _redirects
(/drugs/supplements/<member> and <member>.html -> /drugs/supplements/<main>); view.html?b=<member> forwards on its own.
